conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="covered-call-engine" AND (jsonPayload.event_type="call_scan_skipped_cost_basis_unresolved" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_scan_skipped_cost_basis_divergent" OR textPayload:"call_scan_skipped_cost_basis_unresolved" OR textPayload:"call_scan_skipped_cost_basis_divergent")

documentation.content: A held symbol was blocked because its cost-basis floor could not be resolved or diverged from the cross-check (fail-closed — no call written). Persistent firing means a symbol is stuck unwritable. FC-050/FC-065 lineage.
